sentences.text: Considering the fact that there is no material to substantiate that the seized article were stolen property nor there is material to substantiate that the same was prohibited food item, hence, let the seized article be released immediately in favour of the petitioner on execution of surety bond of Rs.5,00,000/- (rupees five lakhs) along with two sureties of the like amount.
No coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case till further orders.

Heard the parties.
Further, prayer is for release of the seized Pan Masala.
The quashment of first information report has been sought for on the ground that the informant is not a competent person to lodge the first information report for offence committed under the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction of Sales) Regulation, 2011.
The learned counsel for the State-respondents seeks four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
